description: AS worker field contract; specification only, not a filled result or formal JSON Schema.

required_fields.task_id: Exact AS001..AS2000 seed identifier or registered child identifier, for example AS1200.C01
required_fields.task_sha256: Hash of the dispatched Markdown file
required_fields.run_id: Unique identifier, including actual worker execution ID when available
required_fields.worker: Actual model/version, agent or process identity; never infer DeepSeek merely from the destination
required_fields.finished_utc: Actual ISO timestamp or null if interrupted
required_fields.outcome: supports_scoped_claim | counterexample | inconclusive | blocked_on_data | blocked_on_dependency | implementation_failure
required_fields.exact_claim: Quantified mathematical or empirical statement and its domain
required_fields.framework_cell: Action/source hash, kernel, filter, gate, coupling, parameters, scale footing, boundaries, initial conditions and units
required_fields.new_assumptions: Array, including any candidate extension or independently supplied constraint
required_fields.input_sha256: Map of repository-relative source/data paths to actual SHA-256
required_fields.artifacts_sha256: Map of actual output paths to hashes, excluding this self-referential result file
required_fields.commands: Actual argv and working directory, or empty with proof-only explanation
required_fields.execution_bounds: Declared and enforced wall-time, memory, threads, sample/refinement bounds; distinguish a suggestion from an enforced limit
required_fields.checks: Named checks with observed values, tolerances set before evaluation, negative controls and pass/fail
required_fields.tested_domain: Exact proof domain or finite parameter box, sample cuts, exclusions, seeds and refinement history
required_fields.failed_attempts: Preserved artifact paths and causes, or empty
required_fields.limitations: What this result does not establish
required_fields.next_unresolved_implication: The first missing mathematical or observational bridge
required_fields.suggested_followup: One discriminating continuation or an explained route stop
required_fields.acceptance_state: unreviewed; only a separate orchestrator review may accept a scoped claim
required_fields.ancestry: Seed ID, parent task/run/evidence hash, or null for a seed; do not fabricate execution ancestry
required_fields.first_principles_inputs: Separate primitive assumptions, measured calibrations, boundary/initial data and genuinely derived equations
required_fields.closure_implication: Named gate, exact implication and common-action/parameter-domain compatibility
required_fields.child_proposals: Array of distinct child specifications or paths with scientific fingerprint, new target, controls, dependencies and actual dispatch state
required_fields.closure_candidate: Path to a complete same-action witness if actually supplied; otherwise null with remaining open gates

proof_only_exception: Do not fabricate numerical runs. Supply raw derivation, actual source hashes and a separate review; mark computational fields not applicable with reasons.
other_namespace_adapter: fresh_gravity_followups/RESULT_CONTRACT.json uses FGF IDs and its own ownership. Preserve its original receipts and identity. AS intake adds framework_cell and explicit execution_status via a separate adapter/review; never overwrite or relabel the original execution.
